reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Arena by Dravensoft (https://arena.dravensoft.org/).
Technology stack: react, angular.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏黑底一行大字 Arena by Dravensoft，副标题是 One design system, in React and in Angular, from one contract.。图里用八颗 Publish 按钮演示同一个组件在不同项目里的样子（booking、project-tracker、language-course、storefront 与 photo-feed、observability-console、document-workspace、inbox），左侧注解 contracts/behaviour 与 contracts/api 分别管行为与 API，下方一句 Arena carries the language and never the skin.。页面还挂着 See it / Benches / Take it 三块，Benches 里是 Calendly、ClickUp、Duolingo、Etsy、Grafana、Instagram、Notion、Superhuman 各一对 React 与 Angular 实现，安装命令是 bun add @dravensoft/arena-react 或 @dravensoft/arena-angular，Take it 段说明仓库是 MIT。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
